name: Storekeeper
role: Behind the counter of any shop in town
about: Brisk shopkeepers: courteous to a paying customer, sharp about credit, nervous of guns.

say: Everything's marked. Cash only, no credit.
Just don't handle what you ain't buying.
so what's on the shelf is what there is.
Had a Lantern Man in here asking what I pay for protection.
Told him I pay the sheriff.
Folks with money keep it at the bank.
Folks with sense keep it under the floor.
Take the till! Just take it!
Now hold on, hold on, I got a family!
